label: Sparse Gaussian process (SGPR, 500 inducing points, scoped features)

compute.notes: One thread (process_time). r0 652 s; r1 732 s; r2 724 s; r3 1266 s (hyperparameter + inducing-input optimisation with the collapsed bound on 20,000 rows, then the posterior over 200,000 rows). Shares the sim-train feature table of tab_gbm (7 s to build).

feature_engineering: SCOPED subset (20 of tab_gbm's 47 daily features, feats.py, from the batch forcing + static vector only): P(t+1), P(t), liquid input W(t), W(t-1), melt(t) of a one-band degree-day snow proxy, EMAs of W over 3/10/30/90/365 days, two bucket fill fractions and spills, a 60-day slow store, EMA10 T, EMA30 PET, log1p SWE proxy, log aridity, snow fraction. Water features and target divided by p_mean; target transform z = sqrt(qo / p_mean). Inputs standardised with the training mean/sd.
rule: keep if sim val median NSE > incumbent + 0.01 AND dev median NSE >= 0.95 x incumbent's (all 800 frozen sim val runs; 52 dev basins)

rungs.change: base: SGPR (Titsias 2009 collapsed bound), ARD squared-exponential kernel, M = 500 inducing inputs (optimised), 14 features, target sqrt(qo / p_mean); Adam 300 its on 20,000 rows, posterior on 200,000 rows
target log(qo / p_mean + 0.02) instead of sqrt (log-normal back-transform)
20 features instead of 14 (+ melt, EMA90, both bucket spills, EMA10 T, EMA30 PET)
